text:
micah: Quick sync: support keeps asking what 'preview' actually does vs apply. Need a clear API contract and minimal telemetry.

marta: Agreed. Console shows diff+simulation but no audit id. That's causing trouble.

dyson: Important: preview must not write to production metrics (SLO pollution). It should be read-only. Log an audit event and small-sample telemetry only.

laura: API sketch: POST /v1/configs/preview -> {preview_id, diff, simulation, warnings}. preview_id links to audit logs.

micah: Sampling: default 1% for preview telemetry. If preview touches sensitive keys (auth/quotas/kms) escalate to 100% and tag the event.

dyson: We'll mark sensitive fields in schema and the preview endpoint will bump sampling. Also add a header X-Config-Mode: preview|preflight|apply.

laura: Preflight mode runs the simulator synchronously (5s timeout). If constraint or capacity checks fail, return 409 + actionable details. No side-effect on routing metrics.

marta: Console UX: show "PREVIEW (not applied)" pill with preview_id and a "Promote to canary" action that preserves cohort/sampling and stores an immutable snapshot.

ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window Tue 02:00 UTC. Preflights must complete before window to be included.

micah: Action items: laura docs API + header; dyson implement audit + sampled telemetry + sensitive escalation + preflight capacity guard; marta add badge + promote flow and RFC. We'll sync Wed.
